title: Поговори со сверстником о предпочтениях
description: Задавай вопросы сверстнику из другой страны о технологиях, хобби, здоровье и планах на будущее (8 класс)

sections.name: Technology and social media
questions: Do you spend much time on social media every day?
What kind of apps do you usually download on your smartphone?
Do you prefer texting your friends or calling them?
How often do you check your notifications?

sections.name: Hobbies and free time
questions: What do you usually do in your free time after school?
Do you play any computer games or do you prefer active sports?
Do you listen to music when you do your homework?
Does your school have a drama or an art club?

sections.name: Health and lifestyle
questions: Do you eat a lot of junk food or do you try to keep a healthy diet?
How much water do you drink during the day?
Do you often feel stressed before exams at school?

sections.name: School and future job
questions: What subjects do you study at school?
Do you have a part-time job on weekends or holidays?
What do you want to be when you finish school?

sections.name: Environment and city
questions: Do you and your family recycle paper, plastic and glass?
Do teenagers in your country care about the environment?
What do you do to help the environment?
